page: Cron plugin for scheduling jobs in Elysia. @elysia/cron installation. cron() method for job registration. name for job identification. pattern cron syntax with 6 fields (second minute hour day month dayOfWeek). run() callback for job execution. Registered to store by name. cronner library backend. Predefined pattern functions and constants. Patterns.everySecond() etc aliases. Pattern generation by Crontab Guru. timezone configuration. startAt, stopAt scheduling. maxRuns maximum executions. catch option for error handling. interval minimum seconds between runs. .stop() method for manual job termination. Questions: How do I schedule cron jobs? What cron pattern syntax is used? How do I stop cron jobs?

sections.manifest: Cron job creation and configuration. cron() method adds job to Elysia. CronConfig parameters. name: string for job identification. pattern: string cron syntax expression. run: function callback. Cron syntax: 6 fields with optional seconds. Crontab Guru tool for pattern generation. Cronner library configuration. timezone Europe/Stockholm format. startAt schedule start time. stopAt schedule stop time. maxRuns maximum execution count. catch boolean for error handling. interval minimum seconds between executions. Questions: How do I create a cron job? What fields are in cron syntax? How do I configure job parameters?

Manual cron job termination. Access job from store.cron.jobName. .stop() method to halt job. Graceful job stopping. Running jobs stopped immediately. Questions: How do I stop a cron job? How do I access a job by name?

Predefined cron patterns. @elysia/cron/schedule module. Patterns object with functions. everySeconds(N), everyMinutes(N), everyHours(N). everyHoursAt(hours, minutes). everyDayAt('HH:MM'). everyWeekOn(Patterns.MONDAY, 'HH:MM'). everyWeekdayAt('HH:MM'). everyWeekendAt('HH:MM'). Function aliases: everySecond(), everyMinute(), hourly(), daily(), everyWeekday(), everyWeekend(), weekly(), monthly(), everyQuarter(), yearly(). Predefined constants: EVERY_SECOND, EVERY_5_SECONDS, EVERY_10_SECONDS, EVERY_30_SECONDS, EVERY_MINUTE, EVERY_5_MINUTES, EVERY_10_MINUTES, EVERY_30_MINUTES, EVERY_HOUR, EVERY_2_HOURS through EVERY_12_HOURS, EVERY_DAY_AT_1AM through EVERY_DAY_AT_11PM, EVERY_DAY_AT_NOON, EVERY_DAY_AT_MIDNIGHT, EVERY_WEEK, EVERY_WEEKDAY, EVERY_WEEKEND, EVERY_1ST_DAY_OF_MONTH_AT_MIDNIGHT, EVERY_1ST_DAY_OF_MONTH_AT_NOON, EVERY_2ND_HOUR, EVERY_2ND_HOUR_FROM_1AM_THROUGH_11PM, EVERY_2ND_MONTH, EVERY_QUARTER, EVERY_6_MONTHS, EVERY_YEAR, EVERY_30_MINUTES_BETWEEN_9AM_AND_5PM, EVERY_30_MINUTES_BETWEEN_9AM_AND_6PM, EVERY_30_MINUTES_BETWEEN_10AM_AND_7PM.
